items.title: Chat retention
items.question: How long should finished chats stay in the sidebar?
items.explanation: Finished chats move to the archive after a while so the sidebar stays short.
items.example: A chat you finished on Monday leaves the sidebar the next Monday.
items.current: Finished chats stay in the sidebar until you archive them.
items.recommendation: Archive after a week: recent chats stay at hand and the list stays short.

choices.label: Archive after a week
choices.effect: Chats older than seven days move to the archive.

choices.label: Archive after a month
choices.effect: Chats older than thirty days move to the archive.

choices.label: Never archive
choices.effect: The sidebar keeps every chat until you archive it.

technical.detail: Archiving sets the session's archived flag; nothing is deleted.

items.title: Run notifications
items.question: Where should a finished run notify you?
items.explanation: A run that ends while you are away sends one notification.
items.current: Runs notify on this device only.
items.recommendation: Notify on every signed-in device so a long run reaches you anywhere.

choices.label: Every device
choices.effect: Each signed-in device shows the notification.

choices.label: Email
choices.effect: The notification arrives as an email instead.

answer.label: Email
answer.effect: The notification arrives as an email instead.

items.title: Appearance
items.question: Which appearance should new devices start with?
items.explanation: A device you sign in on for the first time uses this until you change it there.
items.current: New devices follow the system appearance.

choices.label: Follow the system
choices.effect: Light or dark follows the device setting.

answer.label: Follow the system
answer.effect: Light or dark follows the device setting.

outcome.note: New devices follow the system appearance.

answer.label: Archive after a month
answer.effect: Chats older than thirty days move to the archive.
